encoord is a small and growing software company that helps energy stakeholders plan for the future. encoord develops and commercializes software for integrated planning across electric generation, transmission, and distribution, as well as electric and gas infrastructure. encoord’s flagship integrated planning software SAInt is designed for workflows that require iteration across two or more of the following modeling domains: power system capacity expansion optimization, power system production cost optimization, balanced AC power flow of transmission networks, contingency analysis, unbalanced AC power flow simulations of distribution networks, and gas hydraulic simulations of gas transmission and distribution networks.
With offices in the United States and Germany, our team of twenty employees serves electric and gas utilities, system and market operators, and asset developers worldwide.

Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing. Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Team

Raisin helps customers grow their wealth through savings and investments without barriers. But even the best products and the smoothest experience lose their value if customers pay more tax than they need to, or have to work out, declare and settle their taxes themselves. The Customer Taxation Team makes sure they don’t.  We design how tax works in Raisin’s tax-advantaged products, a growing part of our offer. Examples include the new Raisin Cash ISA in the UK and the Raisin Kinderdepot, a children’s investment account that uses the child’s tax allowances automatically. We also calculate and withhold tax on the interest and returns customers earn, handle their tax exemption orders and non-assessment certificates, and provide the annual tax documents they need for their tax return. And we send the tax reports that authorities require.

Hi — I'm Grigory, co-founder and CTO at Secfix.
At Secfix we're building security compliance systems for teams and agents to become and stay compliant with less effort. We're already the category leader in Europe. AI is changing how software gets built, and we're shaping the tools this new era requires.
I've spent most of my career believing that the best engineering leaders aren't the ones who run the most meetings. They're the ones who make everyone around them faster, clearer, and more proud of their work — and they can do that because they've been through the hard technical problems themselves.
Since we started, I've done the engineering management myself: 1:1s, hiring, design reviews, performance conversations. The team is 8 engineers and 2 product designers, and I'm spread across too many things. If we were a football team, we'd be a good regional side that just made it to the Bundesliga — talented, hard-working, winning quite a few games. Now we need a coach who's played at Champions League level and can take us there to win every week.
That means a top-notch engineer who leads from the codebase. Someone who owns the technical decisions, sets the pace, and has product taste — who notices when a feature takes three weeks that should take one, and when it ships on time but isn't good enough. About the Role

As an HPC Security Researcher, you bring deep expertise in high-performance computing, software development in C/C++ or Rust/Python, backed by a minimum MSc in HPC, Scientific Computing, or related discipline. description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a Senior Embedded (ARM) Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen and own the real-time firmware that turns our control electronics into a working quantum computer. You will work on our next-generation system, where the control electronics are being integrated into a single, highly integrated chip. You sit at the heart of the machine, between the hardware that generates the pulses and the higher-level software that describes the experiments. Timing is not a detail here; it is the product. You are the person who makes sure the right signal reaches the ions at the right nanosecond, reliably, run after run. 

 Responsibilities:
Own the embedded firmware on our ARM-based control platform, from architecture through implementation to on-hardware debugging

Develop and maintain the real-time software layer that coordinates pulse sequencing, timing, and data flow across our highly integrated control chip

Write and maintain the low-level drivers and board support the…

description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

The Role

As Principal, Business Development for Healthcare & Life Sciences in EMEA, you will be a strategic partner to regional Sales and Sales Engineering leadership. You will help define where and how Everpure wins in European healthcare and life sciences, then translate that strategy into field execution, organizational capability, customer engagement, partner motions, pipeline, and bookings.

You will lead the development of a multi-year EMEA HLS growth strategy across providers, payers, and life sciences. This includes identifying the most important market opportunities, shaping vertical and horizontal plays, and aligning Sales, SE, Marketing, Alliances, Product, and executive leadership around measurable outcomes.

At Lokalise, we make it easy and profitable for businesses to expand into new markets. Our AI-powered localization platform helps companies manage both software and marketing content from a single, unified environment — ensuring every team speaks with one voice across every language and channel.

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

title: Founding Engineer - Ambient Care Startup
summary: Stage: Pre-seed. Location: Cambridge/London, UK. Comp: Competitive + Equity  About Subtle Most families find out something's wrong too late: a fall, a missed check-in, a change no one noticed until…
description:
Stage: Pre-seed. Location: Cambridge/London, UK. Comp: Competitive + Equity

About Subtle
Most families find out something's wrong too late: a fall, a missed check-in, a change no one noticed until it became a crisis. We're building ambient sensing for the elderly and vulnerable at home, technology that quietly looks out for the people we love without asking them to wear anything or change how they live. We're early. We're validating with real customers, building the first hardware, and looking for the person who'll help turn this from an idea into a product families can trust with something this personal.

We are building this from scratch inside Founders Factory's studio, with a dedicated pre-seed investment, hands-on studio support across product, design, talent and growth, and a six-month build programme to get from concept to a fundable, in-market product. This venture has secured a major European technology partner. The founding CEO is already in place. We are now looking for the technical other half of the founding team.

The role
You'll be our first engineering hire, working directly with the founder(s) and carrying real authority over what we build and how. It's a hands-on role that spans hardware and software, and a leadership one too, since you'll grow the team that follows you.

Responsibilities
Own hardware validation and bench testing end to end, and lead our manufacturing path. Whether that ends up being an outsourced partner or in-house, you're the one…

description:
Got Drive? Join AnyVan as we make moving anything, anywhere miles better and build a career that moves just as fast. 

Back in 2009, our Chairman Angus saw half-empty vans everywhere and knew there had to be a better way! That's how AnyVan began. He set out to create the world's most efficient logistics technology and help halve the number of wasted miles by filling those empty vans. 

Since then we've become the nation's favourite way to move, with over 150k five-star reviews and 5 million customers in the UK and Europe. Our team of 400 AnyVanners across London, Cape Town and Bogota is proving that moving doesn't have to cost the earth by helping save 8,520 tonnes of Carbon each year. 

We’re looking for a French Markets Guru to own and scale AnyVan’s marketing and growth in one of our most important expansion markets. Reporting to the CMO, you’ll define and execute the French go‑to‑market strategy, working closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, Pricing and Operations.

This is a high‑impact, high‑ownership role: you’ll combine sharp strategic thinking with hands‑on execution, bringing deep local market insight and broad channel expertise to acquire customers, improve conversion and accelerate revenue growth. It’s fast‑paced, opportunity‑rich, and ideal for someone who loves building from the ground up.

title: Risk & Control Manager
summary: About Pleo Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that…
description:
About Pleo
Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.
The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.
Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! Join Us at the Forefront of Quantum Computing Innovation 🚀

 Role overview
We are looking for a Process & Characterisation Engineer to prepare and validate GaAs/AlGaAs samples containing InAs quantum dots (QDs) through the first steps of our single-photon source fabrication flow.
The role combines hands-on cleanroom processing – chemical treatment, PECVD deposition and high-temperature annealing – with optical characterisation of the QDs before and after each step. The data you produce decides whether a sample is ready to move forward, and how the process recipes should be adjusted.
You will start by running an established, well-documented procedure with rigour and consistency. As you build expertise, the role is designed to grow: within your first year, you will contribute to optimising the process, automating the measurement setups and taking ownership of sample validation for these steps, working closely with both the Production and R&D teams.

Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

summary: At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store.   Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris,…
description:
At Joko, our mission is to we help consumers save time and money when shopping online or in-store. 

Founded in Paris, Joko is a tech company and certified B Corp with over 120 talents across Paris, Barcelona, and New York (and beyond). More than 7 million users already save money every day at 10,000+ merchants with Joko. 

From cashback and automatic coupons to price alerts, we've kept expanding our products to make shopping smarter. Today, Joko is an AI shopping app: with Juno, our shopping assistant, users can find the right product at the best price in only a few seconds, with recommendations that get sharper the more they use it.

Having reached profitability in our core market, we’re now scaling globally, with a strong focus on the US. 

It’s still day 1, come build the future of shopping with us!

🦾 Our Offer Operations team
Joko helps millions of users earn cashback automatically, whether they shop online through affiliate links, activate coupons, or pay in-store with their linked bank card. Behind each of these experiences, there's an operational engine that needs to work flawlessly: transactions must be tracked, cashback must be caught, offers must be reliable, and merchants must perform as expected. When this engine breaks, users don't get paid — and trust erodes fast.
Offer Operations owns that engine. The team's mission is to guarantee the reliability and continuous improvement of Joko's core monetization mechanics — across affiliate tracking, coupons,…

summary: Meet Arago and the Aragonians Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles. The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are…
description:
Meet Arago and the Aragonians
Arago’s mission is to re-engineer the foundations of computing from first principles.
The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.
Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.
Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

What you’ll do
As Technical Sourcer at Arago, you will own the search for some of the most sought-after engineers in the world. We build hardware that has never existed before, and finding the people who can build it requires going far beyond standard recruiting channels.
You will own the full sourcing motion: mapping talent pools, building precise searches, crafting outreach that resonates with passive candidates, and building long-term relationships with high-priority…

title: Finance Manager
summary: Clôtures, facturation à l’usage, automatisation : la fonction finance d’Arkane Cloud est à construire, et c’est vous qui la structurez. Nous créons le poste de Finance Manager pour fiabiliser et…
description:
Clôtures, facturation à l’usage, automatisation : la fonction finance d’Arkane Cloud est à construire, et c’est vous qui la structurez. Nous créons le poste de Finance Manager pour fiabiliser et automatiser la comptabilité, la facturation et le reporting, aux côtés de notre CFO.

Qui sommes-nous ?

Arkane Cloud est un Cloud Service Provider lyonnais, conçu pour l’IA et hébergé en Europe, avec des datacenters à Paris et à Lyon.
Notre propre infrastructure GPU permet à des startups, des chercheurs et des entreprises de déployer leurs modèles en quelques minutes, dans le respect du RGPD et jusqu’à 70 % moins cher qu’avec un hyperscaler.
Notre ambition : bâtir un acteur européen de référence de l’infrastructure IA.

Pourquoi ce poste ?

Arkane Cloud passe de 10 à 50 personnes d’ici fin 2027 et prépare des étapes structurantes : organisation de ses activités et financement de son infrastructure GPU. Pour réussir, il faut des comptes fiables chaque mois, une facturation automatisée et un reporting lisible par des investisseurs.
Rattaché(e) au CFO, vous êtes son point d’appui au quotidien, sur nos deux activités.

Vos missions

• Piloter la clôture mensuelle, pour des comptes livrés en J+10.
• Fiabiliser le chiffre d’affaires Cloud : facturation à l’heure, capacité GPU réservée, prépaiements.
• Structurer puis automatiser les processus finance, avec un objectif clair : 90 % des flux automatisés, 10 % de validation manuelle.
• Consolider le reporting du groupe, avec une vision…

Arkane Cloud est un Cloud Service Provider lyonnais, conçu pour l’IA et hébergé en Europe, avec des datacenters à Paris et à Lyon.

title: Product Manager digital learning

description:
Qui sommes-nous ?
Compani accompagne les structures du médico-social (EHPAD, services d’aide et de soins à domicile, structures du handicap) à recruter, diplômer et fidéliser leurs professionnels, via des parcours de formation qui transforment les pratiques à l’échelle des professionnels, des équipes et des structures.
Société à mission, nous sommes convaincus que les métiers de l’aide et du soin sont des métiers d’avenir, que l’on devrait être fier de choisir, d’apprendre et d’aimer. Au cœur de notre ADN pédagogique ? Le terrain comme source d’apprentissage et la compétence relationnelle que l’on transmet avec la même exigence qu’un geste technique de soin. Aujourd’hui, nous avons accompagné plus de 700 structures et formé plus de 15 000 professionnels, avec un développement fortement accéléré depuis 2 ans.
Compani fait partie du groupe Alenvi (aide à domicile, maisons partagées pour personnes âgées avec troubles cognitifs). Nous sommes une trentaine de collaborateurs, animés par une culture de solidarité, d’autonomie et d’initiative et basés au Kawaa (café et coworking ESS, Paris Bastille).
Notre besoin
Compani a développé un logiciel SaaS propriétaire. Il permet de planifier, gérer, facturer les formations, en lien avec les formateurs et les structures. Il offre également aux apprenants une expérience digitale, sur laquelle nous souhaitons innover fortement dans les prochaines années en capitalisant sur les nouvelles technologies disponibles comme l’IA.
Nous souhaitons…

summary: Vous souhaitez rejoindre une équipe engagée et bienveillante, prendre part à un projet innovant d’intérêt général qui rassemble l’Etat, les entreprises et l’ensemble des membres de l'écosystème de la…
description:
Vous souhaitez rejoindre une équipe engagée et bienveillante, prendre part à un projet innovant d’intérêt général qui rassemble l’Etat, les entreprises et l’ensemble des membres de l'écosystème de la RSE sur tout le territoire, acquérir de solides compétences en levée de fonds ainsi qu’un réseau professionnel riche ?
Rejoignez-nous, nous recherchons actuellement notre stagiaire chargé(e) du développement et du mécénat.
Description de la Communauté “Les entreprises s’engagent”
“Les entreprises s’engagent”, c’est la Communauté des entreprises françaises engagées, portée par le Ministère du travail et de l’emploi, France Travail et l’association “Les entreprises s’engagent” qui réunit les mécènes de la Communauté.
Première initiative publique-privée du genre, nous animons des coalitions inédites qui réunissent, dans chaque département français, les entreprises de toutes tailles, mais aussi les services de l'État et les collectivités, des décideurs, des associations et des leaders engagés issus de toutes sphères.
Notre Communauté rassemble à ce jour plus de 100 000 entreprises, 101 clubs départementaux et plus de 500 personnes mobilisées pour faire vivre le mouvement quotidiennement partout en France - avec pour ambition d’atteindre 150 000 entreprises d’ici 2027.
Notre conviction est que l'entreprise, quelle que soit sa taille, a un rôle clé à jouer pour répondre aux grands défis sociaux, sociétaux et environnementaux de notre époque.
Nos missions :

description:
For this role, we will only consider candidates who are currently based in the Netherlands.

About SkinVision
Skin cancer is highly treatable when caught early, but limited access to specialist care and long wait times delay diagnosis, increasing the risk of late-stage cases and driving up treatment costs. SkinVision, founded in Amsterdam in 2012, exists to close that gap. Our proprietary AI — certified as a Class IIa medical device under EU regulation, with over 90% sensitivity and 89% specificity — has already helped nearly 3 million people worldwide detect early signs of skin cancer. Today, SkinVision has a database of more than 6 million skin spot assessments and can reach 20 million people through insurer partnerships. High-risk cases are reviewed by a team of dermatologists, who support users in taking the right next step — from urgent care to a specialist referral. We are extending this further, connecting users faster to the specialist care they need. We're a focused, international team, active globally, united by one goal: making early detection accessible to everyone, everywhere. If you join us, you're not just building a product — you're helping close the gap between a person noticing something and getting the care they need.

Wil jij een inhoudelijke bijdrage leveren aan de statistieken van het CBS?

Dit is jouw uitdaging
Het kabinet wil dat Nederland in 2050 volledig circulair is. Om te kunnen volgen of we die doelstelling halen, is betrouwbare informatie nodig over onder andere afval en emissies naar water. Het CBS verzamelt en publiceert deze gegevens voor bedrijven. Daarbij maken we vooral gebruik van gegevens uit het elektronisch Milieujaarverslag (e-MJV), aangevuld met enquêtes.
Naast de hoeveelheid afval en wateremissies brengen we ook de milieukosten van bedrijven in kaart, bijvoorbeeld de kosten voor afvalverwerking en voor het lozen van afvalwater. Hiervoor wordt nu een aparte enquête gebruikt. Maar is dat eigenlijk wel nodig?
Tijdens je stage onderzoek je of we de milieukosten voor afval en wateremissies kunnen berekenen met gegevens die al beschikbaar zijn. Je combineert bijvoorbeeld gegevens over de hoeveelheid afval en geloosd water met bestaande indicatoren, zoals gemiddelde kosten per ton afval en sectorspecifieke kosten per kubieke meter geloosd water.
Je gaat onder andere:
bestaande data en indicatoren analyseren en beoordelen op bruikbaarheid;

onderzoeken welke methode het meest geschikt is om de milieukosten te schatten;

een berekening of model ontwikkelen waarmee de kosten kunnen worden afgeleid;

In a world where geopolitical tensions and security threats are accelerating, the way nations protect people and preserve peace is being redefined. For a long time, innovating in defense was about making tougher hardware. But with the evolution of software and the recent AI disruption, the future of defense is shifting to software-powered unmanned systems that save lives by removing humans from the front line. This is our mission.

At Intelic, we're building the intelligence layer for unmanned systems in defense. As a software-first company, we enable autonomous platforms to operate together - faster, smarter, and more reliably - across complex, mission-critical environments. About Runware

Runware is the AI inference platform that builds and runs its own infrastructure, end to end. Our Sonic Inference Engine has served more than 20 billion requests for over 1 million developers and 500 million end users, with 400,000+ models behind a single integration, at up to 10x lower cost per token than traditional providers.
We are now building the AI Factory that runs it. The Sonic Inference Pod packs 1 MW of custom-designed compute into a 20-foot container with closed-loop, water-free cooling, sited wherever power exists. Pods are live in the US and Europe, and we are scaling to dozens of pods and tens of thousands of GPUs, all operated as one distributed fabric that reroutes traffic the moment a pod goes offline (announcement).
The network is what turns those pods into a supercomputer. That is the job.
The role
As AI Factory Network Architect, you will own the network architecture of Runware's AI supercomputer, from the NVLink domain inside a server to the optical links between pods on two continents. You will set the design, build the first systems with your own hands, and grow the team that runs them.
This is a hands-on leadership role, not a slide-deck role. You will specify the fabrics, validate them on real hardware, debug the first congestion collapse at 3 a.m., and then write the standard so it never happens again. This means solving retrieval, ranking and passage extraction under entirely new access patterns and at significant scale, with systems operating over constantly changing, unstructured data and serving tens of thousands of production workloads 24/7.

description:
ð Build the data layer AI needs to do science
Application deadline: 16 Nov 2026 23:59 CET
About Claims
AI ate the Internet, but it can't digest science yet. A paper is thousands of words of prose written for humans, but an AI agent doing research needs to know what was claimed, what evidence supports it, and how far to trust it. Claims turns the scientific literature into exactly that: every claim, tied to its evidence, as structured data that models and agents can query.
We're a startup and run as Subnet 111 on Bittensor. Since our mainnet launch on 28 August 2026, an open competition of miners has processed more than 10,000 papers, and every record was checked by our validator before it entered the dataset. The competition keeps raising the bar: miners keep finding ways to beat our own reference pipeline, and every win becomes part of the standard the whole network is scored against.
The team
Claims was founded by two professors of economics and a senior engineer.
Philipp Koellinger, CEO, is a professor of economics and an experienced entrepreneur: founder of DeSci Labs and the DeSci Foundation, and co-builder of SciWeave with Ogban.
Christian Roessler, co-founder, is a professor of economics and game theorist. He designs the incentive mechanism that makes the miner competition work.
Ogban Ugot, engineering, is a senior backend and machine learning engineer. He built SciWeave, the Claims miner, validator and data pipeline, and you will work with him every day.

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. Learn more about Privy: Privy and Stripe: Bringing crypto to everyone

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste: Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge - you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset: A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Enterprise Product team is responsible for bridging the gap between Stripe's core capabilities and the bespoke needs of the world's largest organizations. We are hiring product managers who will be aligned to specific priority industries (e.g., insurance, healthcare, public sector), with each product manager acting as the "CEO" of their assigned vertical—identifying high-leverage opportunities, building 0-to-1 products to solve industry-specific blockers, and influencing our global product roadmap. You will be a critical partner to GTM leadership (Sales, Partnerships, Marketing) and a navigator across the broader Product organization. We are looking for high-agency builders who thrive in ambiguity and know how to move mountains through both direct execution and cross-functional influence.

What you'll do

We're hiring a product manager to own Stripe's product strategy and execution across our priority industry verticals, starting with…

description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join

Airbnb's Marketing organization partners closely with our Global Partnerships team to turn commercial deals into brand-building moments. Our partners' channels carry audience reach, trust, and cultural credibility — when we show up well on them, we drive bookings, brand love, and reach beyond our owned brand and paid media. This role sits within Marcomm/Marketing, working shoulder-to-shoulder with Global Partnerships (who own the commercial relationship) as well as Creative, PGM, Comms, and Regional Marketing to bring partner storytelling to life, held to the same bar as Airbnb's own brand campaigns.

The Difference You Will Make

As Lead, Partnership Marketing, you'll own the marketing strategy and execution across Airbnb's partner portfolio — turning each partnership's commercial objective into a compelling marketing plan with clear success measures. You'll be the connective tissue between our partners' brand systems and Airbnb's, building campaigns that live on partner channels while staying integrated with Airbnb's owned storytelling. About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge—you will often be "the PM."

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

Who we are
About Bridge

We're creating an entirely new payments platform, built with stablecoins, to simplify global money movement. Bridge enables faster, cheaper payments and borderless access to dollars via stablecoins. Through our APIs, businesses can send and receive funds across borders faster and cheaper vs. SWIFT and other fiat-only rails. Our virtual accounts enable international consumers and businesses to easily access, store, and spend US dollars. Our payouts infrastructure enables platforms to disburse USD to anyone globally. We believe many trillions of dollars will move and settle through stablecoin payment rails. Bridge is pulling this future forward.

We have a small team of people who have previously built financial infrastructure at some of the world's leading companies (Coinbase, Stripe, Square, Brex, Upstart, DoorDash, Airbnb), and each and every one of them chose Bridge because they fundamentally believe that stablecoins will be a critical piece of financial infrastructure that allows for the improvement of global money movement.

High urgency: Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly.

Airbnb's Online Data organization gives every engineer at Airbnb the power to build real-time data experiences — through simple, intuitive tools, without needing deep database expertise.

Within Online Data, the Storage Foundation team owns the online serving stores and databases that power Airbnb. We build and operate Airbnb's source-of-truth database: an open-source, distributed NewSQL system running on stateful Kubernetes. It stores critical data — users, listings, and more — and handles over half of all of Airbnb's online OLTP traffic. Our charter: keep this database reliable, secure, scalable, fast, correct, well-tested, and cost-efficient — at Airbnb's scale.

The Community You Will Join

Airbnb’s Data Infrastructure organization builds the platforms that power data across the company. Within it, the Data Movement & Transformation (DMT) pillar builds the platform that moves data between Airbnb’s storage engines and transforms it along the way.

Today, data moves through many bespoke, one-off pipelines that are built and maintained differently by each team. We’re replacing them with one unified, declarative platform. You define data once, and it is replicated everywhere it needs to go. This work underpins Airbnb’s Data as a Service initiative.

You’ll join the team that owns three connected layers of that platform:

Control plane: the layer that turns declarative data definitions into running pipelines, including provisioning, runtime selection, and lifecycle management.

Schema: how schemas are defined, tracked, and evolved safely across every system and engine.

Realtime Data Infrastructure (RTDI): Kafka and the streaming transport layer that real-time data flows through at scale.

description:
Who we are

About Privy

Our mission is to make privacy and user ownership the default online. To do so, we build simple, flexible APIs and tools for developers that make it easy to build new products on crypto rails.

Privy owns the abstractions and infrastructure layer above wallets, integrating across chains, third-party providers, and Stripe products like Treasury and Link. We get to solve hard technical problems while leveraging Stripe's distribution to reach customers like Ramp, Klarna, Deel, Kraken, Hyperliquid, and Fomo — powering experiences for both mainstream users and crypto natives.

About the team

Engineering at Privy is distinguished by:

High urgency—Shipping very small iterations, very fast, to learn very quickly. 

Product taste—Our customers are developers, and to build effective products for them requires technical knowledge —you will often be "the PM".

Security mindset—A great portion of our product is trust. While we have a dedicated security team, every engineer brings security to their designs from the start.

In practice, we use boring technology like Node, React, and AWS so we can focus our engineering energy entirely on pushing the boundaries of Privy's core product, e.g. through hardware enclaves, multi-region low-latency APIs, and blockchain abstractions that are accessible to mainstream developers.

As an Engineering Manager at Privy, you will lead, grow, and shape high-performing engineering teams that make a massive impact on our product and…

About the team

Radar helps businesses prevent fraud and abuse without getting in the way of legitimate customers. We combine machine learning powered by Stripe’s global network with intuitive dashboard experiences and developer APIs, to give our users comprehensive controls and insights to protect their business against threats ranging from payment fraud and card testing to bot and free trial abuse. 

Fraud doesn’t stand still, and it isn’t limited to checkout. As businesses launch new products and business models, attackers find new ways to exploit them. We obsess about understanding those attacks, identifying defenses that work, and making sophisticated fraud prevention simple for the businesses that depend on us to help them protect and grow their revenue with confidence.

What you’ll do

As a product manager on the Radar team, you’ll help customers, developers, and partners bring fraud prevention naturally into the systems and workflows they rely on. You’ll shape products that make fraud management feel effortless, connecting Radar’s capabilities to the tools and experiences our users build and run.

You’ll work at the intersection of customer needs and commercial opportunities to shape what we build and how we bring it to market. Working closely with engineering, data science, design, and go-to-market teams, you’ll build products and relationships that deliver lasting value to customers and partners. Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their in revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

What you’ll do

You will act in a player-coach capacity and will be accountable for supporting associates in delivering against target set goals and mentoring in subject matter expertise. You will manage a small team of TechOps Payments Analysts. 

Responsibilities

Champion metrics-driven analysis to continuously assess and optimize team performance, with a strong focus on automation 

Leverage automation to streamline data reporting and deliver timely, data-driven insights to management/key stakeholders 

Utilize data as a core tool for guiding people management strategies and optimizing team productivity 

Play a key role in weekly business reviews (WBR), using data to lead discussions support decision-making

Manage capacity and scheduling, dividing and assigning work between team members.

Lead independent discussions with TechOps, Engineering and XFN Partners to unblock complex reconciliation issues.

description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

Description

Airbnb is a mission-driven company dedicated to helping create a world where anyone can belong anywhere. It takes a unified team committed to our core values to achieve this goal. Airbnb's various functions embody the company's innovative spirit, and our fast-moving team is committed to leading as a 21st century company.

The AirCover team is charged with ideating, building, launching, and managing the AirCover business inside of Airbnb. We have a huge responsibility to our community of Hosts and Guests to be there when things don’t go exactly as planned with their reservations. We have a lot of work to do in the coming years and we are looking for someone who will help us manage all of the things that need to be done to deliver best-in-class services to our community.

The Claims Experience team is responsible for providing premium support  for our users by tailoring the experience and services we offer to their own specific needs so that everyone can host and travel with confidence. title: Emergency Response Manager, APAC
summary: Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every…
description:

The Community You Will Join: 

This position is employed by Airbnb Inc., however the role will provide direct support to Airbnb.org, an independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit that focuses on emergency response and provides temporary housing for people in times of crisis. Airbnb.org is governed by an independent Board of Directors and its mission is to provide emergency housing in times of crisis. From Australia to France, hosts have offered to open up their homes and helped provide accommodations to over 250,000 people. Our goal is to exponentially increase Airbnb.org’s reach and impact over the next three years. Learn more at Airbnb.org.

The Difference You Will Make:

You will manage Airbnb.org’s emergency responses in the APAC region but will also be expected to support responses globally as required. You will monitor disasters around the world, decide with your manager when an event meets our activation criteria, stand the response up, and manage it through to close-out.

You will do this work with partners on the ground. Local nonprofits and agencies find displaced people, confirm eligibility, and provide case…

The Community You Will Join: 

The world is changing how it works; not just in where we do it, but in how fast and how well we can do it. Airbnb has already shown that we can move with speed and intention.  We navigated a pandemic, rebuilt our company from the ground up, had a successful IPO, and shipped product upgrades – all while working remotely. That experience didn't just change where we work. It changed what we believe is possible.

Now, a new shift is underway. AI is fundamentally changing the leverage available to every team – compressing timelines, breaking down traditional job description silos, raising the ceiling on quality, and enabling small, focused groups to accomplish what once required much larger ones. At Airbnb, we are not treating AI as a future consideration. We are moving fast to embed it into how we operate today – using it to multiply the impact of every employee, every system, and decisions we make every day. The companies and teams that embrace this shift with urgency and discipline will define what's possible in the years ahead. We intend to be one of them.

Airbnb's mission is to create a world where people can Belong Anywhere. Our community of guests and hosts rely on Airbnb around the clock to facilitate millions of stays and experiences per day.

The Observability team builds the platform Airbnb engineers use to understand how their systems behave in production. We collect, process, store, and query metrics, logs, events, and traces from both backend services and client apps. Our metrics platform alone ingests tens of millions of samples per second across more than a billion active time series. AI agents are now consumers of this data alongside engineers: they query telemetry to write and validate code and to help debug production issues. We continue to invest in reliable and efficient real time system for both AI and human access.

As a Staff engineer, you will set the technical direction for a major area of the Observability platform and lead it from design through production. Problems in front of us include:

description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.

description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The Homes Supply team plays a critical role in ensuring Airbnb secures a diverse and high-quality supply of stays listings. Efforts are aimed at meeting the expectations of guests by ensuring a wide offering of high-quality listings at compelling values are available for every search.

The Difference You will Make:

In this role, you will lead a team of Market Associates responsible for a high-velocity, input-driven account management motion supporting our long tail of Small/medium sized Hosts. You will own execution excellence across rapid optimisation workflows, holding the team accountable to activity-based KPIs while driving consistent, scalable impact across the region.

You will also serve as a key stakeholder and operator for all scaled supply acquisition and retention initiatives within your assigned territory. This includes organising and executing regional roadshows and events, developing strategies to grow and retain supply, and rapidly scaling best practices across the team. The role partners closely with Host Services and Community teams to ensure seamless delivery, strong…

title: Account Executive, FedCiv
summary: About Us  At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties…
description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…

description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the…
